limitations: Only source structural applicability; business SQL/auth/workspace/tree/history/process assertions requirefresh490andindependentresultreview.

barrier_dispatcher.statement: Each case starts actual accepted_start_dispatcher_child with dispatcher-cut-logs/dispatcher.stdout and dispatcher.stderr and waits on production phase barrier, verifies live PID/startticks. These tests release the barrier; they never call kill_at_barrier, the only writer of dispatcher-barrier.json. Therefore no separate dispatcher-barrier JSON is required. Actual phased raw filesystem/query snapshots and owner cuts plus fresh JUnit barrier assertions remain mandatory; no serialized barrier event sequence or JUnit-only business acceptance is claimed.

cleanup.statement: All cases finally _close_case: release/close real barrier within originaldeadline, stop owned children, append stopped identity/outcomes, assert expected exits/absence/notforced, and write process-cleanup.json with processes/status. Onfailure only process-cleanup-failure may be written and the fullcandidate mustfail; no optional success evidence waiver. Journal successful started/stopped entries each contain event/pid/start_ticks.

common_prepare.statement: All11 cases call crash.prepare_case, which writes actual workspace-initial-observation, source/environment manifests, process journal and Temporalserver log. Initial JSON contains job_id/tree/marker_bytes_hex, manifests use declared formats/fields.

filesystem.statement: workspace.filesystem_snapshot raw query retains phase/tree/marker_lstat/raw marker_base64/digest/external sentinel raw bytes and workspace row/details. Each test calls this across its actual cut; minimum1 existing remains unchanged. Backend no-runs _no_runs writes actual temporal.list_workflows observations for dispatcher-rejection8 cases; worker3 decode actual history instead.

generation.statement: Literal workspace-stale-generation-claim directory, actual live leasedgeneration1, actual G5 retry/reconcile advancesgeneration2withsametoken/tree. Releaseddispatcher exits3quarantine; actualbackendlistempty. Minimalrepair removesundefinedrun_id detail only. Phasedquerynowretainsattempts and finalraw sixkeys. Sourceacceptance subject toseparateexactreview and executionproofpending.

invalid.statement: Literal dirs workspace-invalid-<damage>; missing/forged/wrong-token/symlink damage is actual. Raw result has damage/workspace_state/attempts/workflow_runs/damaged_tree_unchanged. Onlysymlink writes external-marker-target.json using actualexpected marker format/job_id/workspace_token; rawquerycapturesno-follow sentinel bytes/tree and testassertsunchanged.

nonready.statement: Literal dirs workspace-dispatch-nonready-<lowerstate>; RESERVED/PROVISIONING/ERROR set byactualowner SQL, after_claim_commit barrier, dependency retry no binding/scopes/receipts. Raw result state/attempts/workflow_runs/tree_unchanged.

worker.statement: Literal workspace-worker-nonready-<lowerstate>; after_run_admitted barrier ensuresactualrun thenworkspacebecomesnonready. RealnormalworkerCLI writes process-logs/worker-stdout/stderr. Actualdecoded read_activation wait withnoscheduledproject_activation, no receipt orrevision, oneStarted asserted; rawcompletehistory deterministicPBSeq and JSON state/run_id/read_result/project_activation_scheduled/receipt_count/revision retained.
